title: [Master]-Bug 648672: [Expense Agent][Translation] Agent name is not localized across setup wizard, avatar, and Agent Card
summary: The Expense Agent name is now localized across the setup wizard, avatar, and Agent Card by removing the locked caption restriction in the Agent Metadata Provider.
key_points: Removed Locked=true from Expense Agent metadata-provider caption
Allows translation resources to localize the agent name
